Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates software engineering by asking a model to produce a patch that fixes real issues in open-source Python repositories. Submissions are judged by whether the repository’s tests pass after applying the patch, using a curated set of tasks verified by human annotators to be solvable.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension, Language Production (minor)
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Cognitive Flexibility (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends the SWE-bench setup beyond Python, testing whether models can fix real issues across multiple programming languages and ecosystems. It stresses transferring debugging and patch-construction skills across varied toolchains, conventions, and library APIs.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension, Language Production
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Semantic Understanding & Context Recognition (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger, harder software engineering benchmark designed to better reflect industrially relevant coding work and to be more resistant to contamination. Cognitive Functions:

L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
